provenance: Original project-authored Canvas 2D geometry; no external assets, paid services, or runtime network calls.

assets.collisionRole: none; these entities are never added to simulation state, observations, collision geometry, or agent inputs
assets.selection: bounded deterministic cosmetic hash of match seed and visual ID; does not consume gameplay RNG
assets.reducedMotion: freezes currents, fish, sea life, drifting fragments, and shimmer

assets.collisionRole: none; all dressing is clipped conceptually to authoritative map polygons
assets.selection: deterministic cosmetic hash of match seed and island ID; huts appear only on one of six landmark variants

assets.closeRangeImpact: layered white-gold flash, expanding ring, and ten-ray burst; driven by ProjectileHitShip.closeRange
assets.collisionRole: none; authoritative circle hitbox remains in simulation
assets.weaponCooldownBar: yellow bar below health; empty immediately after firing and fills to a bright ready state from authoritative cooldownTicks

assets.visibility: 128 terrain-clipped rays per friendly sensor; explored mask is remembered per team and reset on replay rewind
assets.reducedMotion: static fog boundaries; no visibility change is inferred from cosmetic motion

assets.collisionRole: authoritative wreck-shoal polygons are solid; decorative hull and bubbles add no geometry
